version.changelog:
internal-comms-midea v1.1.1

- Added a new company newsletter template (examples/company-newsletter.md).
- Expanded How to use to support the newsletter template.
- Removed skill-card.md.
- Improved error handling and degradation strategy sections in SKILL.md.
- Minor wording and formatting adjustments in templates and documentation.

llm.summary: This is a text-only internal communications skill, but some templates tell the agent to broadly search company email, chat, calendars, and documents without clear user approval or source limits.

dimensions.detail: For company-wide newsletters and FAQs, the instructions could cause broad enterprise search and redistribution of sensitive internal information without requiring approved sources, audience checks, redaction, or content-owner confirmation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a pure Markdown/JSON skill with no executable files, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, or install-time scripts observed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Several templates direct broad internal source discovery, including email, messaging, calendars, documents, executive announcements, and high-view strategy documents, with phrases like collecting as much context as possible or reading all available tools comprehensively.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, memory writes, scheduled tasks, privilege escalation, tool wrapping, destructive commands, or credential-handling logic were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent: drafting Midea Group internal reports, newsletters, incident reports, emails, FAQs, and general communications from text templates.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use it for Midea-style internal communications and can keep the agent's enterprise search tightly scoped. Before using newsletter, FAQ, or weekly-report workflows, provide approved channels, folders, date ranges, and audiences, and require review/redaction before sharing generated output.
llm.findings:
[P2] unexpected: The flagged hidden content appears to be a UTF-8 BOM at the start of SKILL.md; I did not find hidden malicious instructions, so this finding is downgraded.
[SQP-2] expected: Using internal sources is purpose-aligned for enterprise communications, but the templates lack explicit consent, least-privilege limits, redaction guidance, and audience controls for sensitive company data.
[T05] expected: The overbroad-access warnings are supported by artifact text in the 3P, newsletter, and FAQ templates; they do not show privilege escalation, but they do show under-scoped use of existing enterprise access.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese language and Midea-specific tone are coherent with the package description and intended audience, so this is not a security concern by itself.
[SQP-1] expected: The activation scope covers broad internal communications, which matches the skill purpose, though users should be aware that generic internal-writing requests may receive Midea-specific formatting and tone.
